intro: A Warden of the Alliance is the heartfelt conclusion to Children's Week for Alliance adventurers guiding a young orphan through Stormwind. After showing Randis the wonders of the kingdom, the hero buys a rack of toy foam swords so the rest of the orphanage can join the fun before returning the boy to Matron Nightingale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have been so very kind to me, friend. I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week. Thank you. I don't wanna be sad about what's happened to me and all - my folks always told me to rise above anything bad that happens. You know, when I grow up I wanna be a hero... Just like you.
I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home. Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is a pleasure to see you again, friend. Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?

clips.title: Completion
paras: May the heavens bless you, friend. You've done more for Randis than most would ever think of doing for him. Thank you - you're a shining star in the skies of the Alliance.
Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. I know that Randis would like that, as would I.
Randis had so much fun with you, friend. He wanted to give you one of his favorite pets to remember him by.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
